body: A lot of this should be forward declared if possible

```suggestion
	ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("redrawn"));
```
"Redrawed" is not a word

Use Title Case for buttons, and `TTRC()` for runtime language changes:

```suggestion
	fetch_btn->set_text(TTRC("Update Parameters"));
```

Scale lines for hiDPI displays:

```suggestion
				draw_line(start_pos, code_editor->get_global_position() + end_pos, line_color, EDSCALE, true);
```

Lines seem a bit too prominent compared to the text right now. I suggest decreasing their opacity a little:

```suggestion
			Color line_color = EditorNode::get_singleton()->get_editor_theme()->get_color(SceneStringName(font_color), EditorStringName(Editor)) * Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7);
```

Seems like all errors are static messages, so you can use TTRC (for auto-translation).
```suggestion
	_show_error(TTRC("Shader must be compiled correctly."));
```
This will need to be updated with `NOTIFICATION_TRANSLATION_CHANGED`.
I assume this is some hack to workaround sizing problems? Aren't deferred calls enough?
This method just calls a method in `code_editor`. Maybe it can be connected to the code editor directly?

Same as above.

```

This could be cached in NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED, to avoid lookup with every redraw (although there is single object for all lines, so it's probably fine).

Also you can `Color(color, alpha)` instead of multiplication.

You could assign it before the condition above, to avoid repeating the check.

This needs to clarify that the node needs to be selected in the inspector. You can edit another resource while a node is still selected, which will trigger the error despite having selected node.

Also, does it need to be for nodes specifically? The previews could work if you edit a material directly (unless the node is needed for more than just parameters?).
The preview also won't work if the Material is not assigned to a `material` property, but I guess that's even more complex to support 🤔
CI will emit error if I will not add that line (for switch conditions).
Yeah it's a hack, without timer when a user press `Expands Bottom Panel` button - the previews will not redraw correctly.
Only if you are matching enum.

I rephrase it like "Select a node used by this shader in the inspector." - this is fine?

Yes, its possible to be used on material without selected Node, but I thought its undesired since in original addon its disabled.

```
